title: primula cuneifolia var. hakusanensis
intro: Primula cuneifolia var. hakusanensis, commonly known as Hakusan Primula or Japanese Primrose, is a plant species that belongs to the Primulaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throats, and skin irritations, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents present in Primula cuneifolia var. hakusanensis have been found to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its medicinal properties.
